title: Сохранить preparing заказ при паузе поиска и продолжить оплату после ready

verify.summary: Independent outcome probes pass; payment gate twice 9/10 due immediate requested/preparing assertion. Original RED path overwritten by native runner; root routes test synchronization and truthful evidence repair, task remains in_progress.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-013.md#FT-013-AC-014 (exact Preparing-order continuity subsection #preparing-order-continuity only): RED: in the existing HTTPS fixture, a paid preparing order is created before redirect, a new search and five real no_matches clear selection and hide its panel/refresh; merely retaining it still leaves pre-redirect ready refresh status-only. GREEN: the same journey keeps the same order ID/panel/refresh through cooldown, owner GET checks that order, ready initiates payment for it without a second POST /orders; pending after redirect gives no paid link until server-confirmed success. Record before/after UI, requests and order identity in .tasks/TASK-151-T3-FT-013-W16/claim-evidence.md. Setup failure is not RED; TASK-150 cookie/count and TASK-145 post-redirect proof stay with their owners.
purpose: Сохранить доступ к уже созданному paid order при пустом выборе после поиска и продолжить оплату в текущей вкладке после готовности ZIP.
success_outcome: Во время cooldown созданный preparing заказ остаётся доступным; pre-redirect refresh проверяет тот же order и после ready продолжает его оплату, post-redirect refresh остаётся status-only, новый непустой выбор использует start().
anti_goals: Нет нового browser/server order history, pre-redirect reload/resume promise, повторного POST /orders, server payment/schema/profile/processing changes, real financial actions или production/deploy.

forbidden_scope: Server, schema, profile and processing source changes
Production/deploy, real financial actions, real provider/email calls or shared operator database
Changes to TASK-145/150 identities, statuses or evidence; search cookie/count implementation
stop_conditions: If another project-authored file is needed, route write-boundary revision before execution; do not write it under advisory touched_files.
Stop on a new public/shared contract, owner or tier change, server payment/state change, production action or irreversible probe.

constraints: Planning Revision 4, design/behavior impact none; one bounded FT-013 AC-014 subset, no new product requirement or AC ID.
Primary owner public browser client/; it calls accepted public APIs. promo retains server profile/order/payment authority; no cross-owner direct writes.
Pre-redirect continuity applies only to an in-memory created order in the current tab; after redirect or reload, existing saved-order status semantics remain.
T3 isolated fixture must use existing disposable DB helper with permission for that test state, safe rerun and cleanup. Never use shared/live DB or actual payment provider.
invariants: Cooldown gates new search POST only; it does not hide an already created order or block owner status GET and payment continuation after ZIP ready.
Exactly the existing order is used: no second POST /orders, no payment before ready, no paid link while pending; entitlement follows server-confirmed status only.
TASK-150 retains cookie/count proof and TASK-145 retains post-redirect proof; regression of those paths is not adoption of their claims.
verification_targets: FT-013-AC-014 Preparing-order continuity: existing HTTPS browser fixture with isolated disposable DB/helper, explicit permission and cleanup, real public search responses (five completed no_matches), actual fixture order state and controlled ZIP/payment/provider stubs. Create paid preparing order before redirect; run new search, clear selection and reach fifth-outcome cooldown. Compare visible order panel/refresh, exact order ID, owner GET count/path, zero search POST during cooldown and exactly one POST /orders over the journey. Advance same order to ready; refresh calls payment only after ready, with same ID and no new order. Record network/UI comparison and safe rerun. No external payment.

Regression for this change: after redirect, pending refresh is status-only and cannot show paid link until server-confirmed success returns the server-issued URL; new nonempty selection follows ordinary start rather than refreshing unrelated old order. Native unit, focused payment browser and search browser gates cover current delta; no repeat of TASK-150 cookie counting or TASK-145 historical proof. Independent /verify PASS, per-task /red-verify semantic-pass, owner closure and fresh FT-013 feature semantic decision follow.
